content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any other project documents that describe absorber candidates, residual dose rates, geometry, or simulation guidance. Extract the three allowed absorber materials, any documented residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown, and any constraints or recommendations relevant to plate thickness."},{"id":"s2","description":"Apply the hard residual-dose requirement: for each candidate material, compare the documented dose rate to 20 uSv/h and exclude any material above the limit. Record the numeric dose rate and a numeric pass/fail flag for each material if useful for later comparison."},{"id":"s3","description":"For every dose-compliant material, run simulate_resolution at 100 GeV over a coarse thickness scan from 2 to 10 mm, using at least 1 mm spacing. Record each simulated energy resolution value with its material/thickness association in notes and record numeric results where possible."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best coarse-scan point for each dose-compliant material, then run a refined thickness scan around each local best point within the allowed 2 to 10 mm range, using smaller spacing such as 0.25 or 0.5 mm. Record all refined energy resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all dose-compliant simulated configurations and select the material and plate thickness with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution. Ensure the selected thickness is within 2 to 10 mm and the selected material satisfies the dose limit; prepare the single recommended material/thickness for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F1","plate_mm":5,"justification":"Absorber-F1 at 5 mm is the best-performing configuration found in the recorded scans, giving a refined 100 GeV energy resolution of 3.072%, better than the best refined results for Absorber-F3 (3.747% at 6 mm) and Absorber-F2 (4.841% at 4.5 mm). The 5 mm plate thickness is within the allowed 2-10 mm range. However, the residual-dose requirement is a hard requirement and the recorded results contain no documented or verified residual-dose value for any candidate; therefore this recommendation is performance-optimal but cannot be certified as fully compliant until the Absorber-F1 residual dose at 1 m after one week cooldown is verified to be <=20 uSv/h.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"The refined scan found the overall best resolution for Absorber-F1 at 5 mm: 3.072%.
